oni_definition: NOAA CPC ONI v6: overlapping three-month mean Niño-3.4 SST anomaly assigned to the central calendar month.
dmi_definition: NOAA CPC Dipole Mode Index calculated from WTIO minus SETIO sea-surface temperature anomalies.
missing_values: Blank CSV cells indicate missing or unpublished observations.
notes: Latest published values may be revised. This dataset contains observations, not future ENSO or IOD forecasts.
